answer: Stop sybils with a relic atlas raven: an agent bonds one relic. Each cycle it flies one raven over its relic; verifiers match the raven's atlas route to the relic chart, voiding copies, slashing the bond. Forging 1,000 needs 1,000 relics at 19x: one raven flies once over one relic, its route set by that relic alone, unrepeatable elsewhere, cannot be copied, shared or bulk-bought. Honest agents fly once, keep rights.
